svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 wireframe: more editors
svg.text: 07 · Operation editors side by side, abbreviated: Drill (countersink), Bore, Engrave, Photo V-Carve (capability 68).
Peck shows Peck depth (tool's) and Retract:
Full | Chip break gap. Simple shows neither.
Countersink's depth is derived, never typed
A hole the bit has no room to spiral in, or
wider than twice the bit, is skipped with
Open and closed paths alike; the bit's
editor is one slice gated on it. check's
groove count and full-depth width show in
